issues.fix_hint: Move the H1 above the headings that precede it, or demote those headings to plain text or a non-heading element. A parser reading the outline meets them before it meets the page's subject, and a snippet built from early page text quotes them instead of the page.
issues.message: One or more headings appear before the page's first H1 in DOM order

issues.fix_hint: Use the adjacent heading level in both directions: an H4 that follows an H2 becomes H3, and a heading returning up the outline steps back one level at a time so each open section closes in order (H3 -> H2 closes one section and starts a sibling, which is correct nesting).
issues.message: Content headings change by more than one level in DOM order, skipping a level down or jumping back up past an open section

issues.fix_hint: Mark template furniture up as what it is -- a menu label or a widget title is not a heading of this document, and repeating it on every page pushes the page's own headings down its outline.
issues.message: A heading sits in the page chrome (header, nav, sidebar or footer) rather than in the content
